data.long_meaning: The owner of Grace and Beauty. The name Fakhriya carries the meaning “Possessing Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Fakhriya usually hope their child will grow to embody possessing grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a woman who embodies the beauty and grace of Allah
data.etymology: Fakhriya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Possessing Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakhriya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: فخرية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من فعل فخر، يعني الشخص الذي يتفاخر بصفاته
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فخرية مشتق من الجذر العربي ف-خ-ر، والذي يعني الفخر والاعتزاز. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرتبطة بالصفات الحميدة في الإسلام. استخدم هذا الاسم في مختلف الثقافات الإسلامية لما يحمله من معاني رفيعة.

in_urdu.name: فخرية
in_urdu.meaning: فخر سے متعلق، اعزاز و فخر کا اظہار کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فخرية ایک عربی نام ہے جو فخر کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام ف-خ-ر کے عربی جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو فخر اور اعزاز کے احساس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان کی شخصیت میں اعزاز و فخر کی معانی کو شامل کرنے کے لیے دیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फखरिया
in_hindi.meaning: फख्र से जुड़ा, सम्मान और गर्व प्रकट करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: फखरिया एक अरबी नाम है जो फख्र के अर्थ में है। यह नाम अरबी मूल फ-خ-र से लिया गया है, जो गर्व और सम्मान की भावना को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम व्यक्ति की विशेषताओं में सम्मान और गर्व की भावना को शामिल करने के लिए दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فخرية
in_pashto.meaning: د فخر څخه مشتق شوی، د ویا او افتخار څرګندولوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فخرية د عربي نوم څخه دی چې د فخر معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښې ف-خ-ر څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د ویا او افتخار احساس څرګندوي. د پښتنو په دود کې، دا نوم د هغوی په شخصيت کې د ویا او افتخار د معانيو د شاملولو لپاره ورکړل شوی دی.

This name is often associated with positive attributes such as honor, pride, and dignity. In Islamic tradition, names are chosen for their meanings and the qualities they evoke. Fakhriya, with its rich etymology and cultural significance, reflects a sense of pride and self-respect.

The name signifies the owner of grace and beauty, a reflection of the Islamic belief in the importance of inner and outer beauty. It is a name that is often given to girls, emphasizing their worth and value in society as possessors of both inner and outer beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fakhriya is a reminder of the deeper beauty that lies within each individual. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that true beauty is not just physical, but also extends to the soul and character of a person. The name serves as a constant reminder for the bearer to strive towards inner beauty and excellence, in addition to physical beauty. The name also reflects the Islamic belief in the grace and mercy of God, who bestows His blessings upon us and imbues us with both inner and outer beauty.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Possessing Grace" symbolizes The owner of Grace and Beauty. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fakhriya serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of possessing grace.
